days_to_cover.label: Rental days a month whose revenue covers what a Hertz car in the Americas loses in the month
days_to_cover.formula: fleet cost per car per month / revenue per rental day

days_to_cover_2024.label: The same in 2024, the year of the EV write-downs
days_to_cover_2024.formula: fleet cost per car per month / revenue per rental day

fleet_cost_per_car_month.label: Fleet cost per car per month: depreciation, rents for leased cars and the result of selling the cars

revenue_per_rentable_car_month.label: Revenue per rentable car per month (excludes cars held for sale)

revenue_per_fleet_car_month.label: Revenue per fleet car per month

fleet_cost_share_of_car_revenue.label: Share of a fleet car's monthly revenue that goes to fleet cost
fleet_cost_share_of_car_revenue.formula: fleet cost per car / revenue per fleet car

rented_days_per_car_month.label: Days a month a fleet car is out on rent, on average

average_vehicles.label: Hertz average fleet in the Americas

months_in_fleet.label: Months the cars sold in 2025 spent in the fleet, on average

program_vehicles_share.label: Share of the Americas fleet at year end with a buyback or guaranteed depreciation from the maker

hertz_2024_vehicle_impairment.label: Hertz 2024 write-down of fleet values (whole company), booked outside the fleet cost per car

hertz_vehicle_sales.label: hertz: cash received from selling fleet cars

hertz_sales_share_of_revenue.label: hertz: car sales as a share of revenue

hertz_gain_on_sale.label: hertz: gain (or loss) on selling the cars

hertz_net_income.label: hertz: net income (or loss) for the year

avis_vehicle_sales.label: avis: cash received from selling fleet cars

avis_sales_share_of_revenue.label: avis: car sales as a share of revenue

avis_gain_on_sale.label: avis: gain (or loss) on selling the cars

avis_net_income.label: avis: net income (or loss) for the year

hertz_costs_of_selling.label: Hertz: costs of selling the cars, included in the result of the sale

hertz_gain_before_selling_costs.label: Hertz: result of selling the cars before the costs of selling
hertz_gain_before_selling_costs.formula: gain (loss) on sale + costs of selling

hertz_sales_share_returning_book_value.label: Hertz: share of the sale cash that only gave back the cars' book value (approximate)
hertz_sales_share_returning_book_value.formula: (car sales - gain before costs of selling) / car sales

avis_fleet_charges.label: Avis Budget: charges for disposing of part of the Americas fleet, included in the loss

avis_gain_before_fleet_charges.label: Avis Budget: result of selling the cars without those charges
